title: The p-th power of a power series in characteristic p is computed coefficientwise
statement: Let $p$ be a prime number, $R$ a commutative ring of characteristic $p$ (for an integer $N$, $N\cdot1=0$ in $R$ if and only if $p\mid N$), $n\ge0$, and $f=\sum_{E\in\mathbf N^n}c_Ex^E$ an element of the formal power series ring $R[[x_1,\ldots,x_n]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], $x^E=x_1^{e_1}\cdots x_n^{e_n}$. Then $f^p=\sum_{E\in\mathbf N^n}c_E^p\,x^{pE}$, where $pE=(pe_1,\ldots,pe_n)$: the coefficient of $f^p$ at $x^{pE}$ is $c_E^p$, and its coefficient at $x^G$ is $0$ whenever some component of $G\in\mathbf N^n$ is not divisible by $p$.
